findings.current: Reality worse than my imagination was waiting for me.
findings.defect: The translation omits the repeated crude register of 거지 같은, weakening the deliberate echo of the preceding line and its darkly comic contrast.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes reality as even more 거지 같은 after imagining something that would make him feel 거지 같아질, so the repeated vulgar phrasing should remain audible.
findings.replacement: A reality even shittier than anything I could imagine was waiting for me.
findings.source: 상상보다 더 거지 같은 현실이 나를 기다리고 있기 때문이었다.

findings.current: My senses, which had been sharp enough to rival a divine artifact only moments ago, had grown dull as an ax abandoned in a ruined cabin.
findings.defect: 신병이기 refers specifically to extraordinary or divine weapons, not the broader category of divine artifacts.
findings.rationale: The weapon comparison supports the repeated image of sharpness and should not be conflated with the established general term 신물, rendered as “divine artifact.”
findings.replacement: My senses, which had been sharp enough to rival a divine weapon only moments ago, had grown dull as an ax abandoned in a ruined cabin.
findings.source: 조금 전까지만 하더라도 신병이기 부럽지 않게 날카롭던 감각은 버려진 오두막의 도끼처럼 무뎌졌고, 언제나 팔랑개비처럼 휘둘렀던 백염은 세상에서 가장 무거운 것이 되어 버렸다.

findings.current: Around a hundred of them had been waiting for the immense vortex created by One Annihilation.
findings.defect: The action is reversed: the mutants were not waiting for the vortex; the vortex was what awaited them.
findings.rationale: The Korean makes 그들을 the object of 기다리고 있던 and the vortex its subject, describing the lethal force they charged into rather than an intentional wait.
findings.replacement: What awaited roughly one hundred of them was the immense vortex created by One Annihilation.
findings.source: 어림잡아 일백에 달하는 그들을 기다리고 있던 것은 일섬이 불러온 강대한 와류였다.

findings.current: Behind the dazzling flash that had erased everything, he remained—a powerless shell of a man.
findings.defect: “Behind” gives 뒤 a spatial reading, while the passage describes Jin’s condition after the flash.
findings.rationale: The Empress is perceiving the aftermath of One Annihilation and Jin’s resulting exhaustion, not locating him physically behind the flash.
findings.replacement: After the dazzling flash that had erased everything, he remained—a powerless shell of a man.
findings.source: 모든 것을 지워 버린 눈부신 섬광 뒤, 힘을 잃고 껍데기만 남아 버린 녀석의 모습이.

findings.current: and the rank-smelling beast blocking his path.
findings.defect: “Rank-smelling” is an unnatural literal collocation and does not clearly convey the contemptuous implication of an old, musty-smelling beast.
findings.rationale: 노린내 나는 is a disparaging odor-based description, while 어느 and 그 앞 identify the beast dismissively as standing before Jin.
findings.replacement: and the musty old beast standing in front of him.
findings.source: 제 몸을 가누는 것조차 힘든 진태경과, 그 앞을 가로막은 어느 노린내 나는 짐승을 갈기갈기 찢어 버릴 수 있게 해 주는 축복.

findings.current: No matter how fast you are, you won’t last long if you take me with you.
findings.defect: The subject is reversed: Jin says that he will not last long while being carried, not that the guardian spirit will fail to endure.
findings.rationale: The following sentences explain that Jin would ask to be put down because he will die unless he circulates his qi, resolving the omitted Korean subject as Jin.
findings.replacement: No matter how fast you are, I won’t last long if you take me with you.
findings.source: 장담하는데, 네가 아무리 빨라도 나 데리고 가면 얼마 못 버텨.

findings.current: What if you die on the way?
findings.defect: The subject is reversed: Jin is asking what she will do if he dies during the journey.
findings.rationale: Her immediate response—“You mustn’t die this easily”—confirms that Jin is referring to his own possible death.
findings.replacement: What if I die on the way?

summary: Three critical subject/action reversals, one meaningful register loss, and three localized terminology or wording issues.
